_comment: Template for <projects>/.claude/settings.json, written by runtime/claude-code/bootstrap.sh with $AGENT_FABRIC_ROOT substituted. Hooks resolve the agent from the OS and show the working copy as context; nothing here names an agent or a project. The GZCoord inbox drains here too: started in the workspace, a session is outside any checkout, and the inbox reads the project and its token from the binding. env disables the harness's own tab-title writer: it writes a prompt-derived topic after every turn, on top of what hooks/tab-title.sh set, so the tab named a conversation instead of the agent (db-admin, 2026-09-15); with it off the hook is the only writer. This scope reaches only a session started from the workspace itself; a session started inside a clone gets the switch from runtime/openrouter/launch, which exports it on every path (2026-09-16). plan-hold.sh runs on every tool call, every prompt and at session end: it marks the account's GZCoord inbox held while the session is in plan mode, and the watch (inbox.mjs --follow) polls nothing while the marker names a live session (2026-09-16). model-fallback-note.sh runs after any model switch and, when the harness made it itself (a safeguard flagged a request), tells the session so with the contagion rule and leaves a marker send.mjs and fabric-status read (2026-09-16).

hooks.command: f="$AGENT_FABRIC_ROOT/runtime/claude-code/hooks/agent-dispatch-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The dispatch guard script was not found; approve only if you have checked model and isolation yourself."}}'; fi

f="$AGENT_FABRIC_ROOT/runtime/claude-code/hooks/subagent-clone-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The subagent clone guard script was not found; approve only if this tool call is not a subagent writing in the session clone."}}'; fi

f="$AGENT_FABRIC_ROOT/runtime/claude-code/hooks/model-switch-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreModelSwitch","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The model-switch guard script was not found; in a broker session a bare model id runs without its family shim. Approve only if the target is a composite or needs no shim."}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: agent-fabric: checking the switch keeps its family shim…
